Subject: POC telemetry & monitoring acceptance checklist (post-call recap)

Hi Alicia / Ben —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and the proposed next steps for the two-week POC we discussed. I captured what we heard on your success criteria and the observability scope we proposed; please flag anything missing.

POC scope (short):
- 2-week dedicated inference test on Redwood Dedicated with your retail recommendation model (v1.2)
- ~50 concurrent requests workload with mixed short/long prompts (see attached fastretail-poc-scope.xlsx)

Primary success criteria (you confirmed):
- Latency: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 250ms
- Stability: <0.5% server errors over test window
- Cost: per-token unit cost within target band (we'll track tokens/sec and projected monthly cost)
- Integration: ability to export logs and traces to FastRetail S3/CloudWatch for audit
- Quality: no more than 3% regression against your reference prompt set (we'll run automated evals)

Observability / monitoring deliverables for the POC (what Redwood will provide):
1) Grafana dashboards (shared read-only link): POC Liveness, Inference Performance, Cost & Throughput, Error Analysis.
2) Traces: OpenTelemetry spans for request lifecycle, sampling at 100% for the POC window; Jaeger-compatible export.
3) Logs: Structured request logs (JSON) with request_id, model_version, prompt_hash, token_count; export via fluentd to your S3 bucket or CloudWatch (your preference).
4) Metrics to monitor (baseline list): requests_per_sec, tokens_per_sec, p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, error_rate_4xx_5xx, gpu_utilization_pct, kv_cache_hit_ratio, model_load_time_ms, queue_depth, batch_size_avg, oom_count.
5) Alerting: email + Slack for p95 latency spike (>500ms) and error_rate >1% sustained 5m.

Ownership & timeline:
- Redwood (Marissa) sets up dashboards and trace export by EOD Wed (2026-06-17).
- FastRetail (Ben) to provide target S3 bucket/CloudWatch destination and service-account creds by Tue (2026-06-16).
- Connor / Sales to validate acceptance criteria and sign-off at end of week 2 (checkpoint call).

Attachments: fastretail-poc-scope.xlsx (workload/testcases), poc-telemetry-checklist.pdf (detailed metrics and dashboard mockups).

Next steps (concrete):
- Ben: reply with preferred log destination and a contact for infra creds by Tue noon.
- Ben / Alicia: confirm the two-week start window (we proposed Wed 6/17 start).
- Redwood (Marissa): I will send the dashboard links + sample trace export once ready.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

Best,

Hi Ben / Alicia —

Thanks — Marissa from Redwood's Solutions Engineering here. Quick note to confirm implementation details and owners for instrumentation. I'll stand up the dashboards and initial trace export; below is the exact plan and some implementation notes so your SRE team can anticipate the payloads and keys.

Implementation plan (deliverable breakdown):
- Trace export:
  - Instrumentation: Redwood will emit OpenTelemetry spans for each inference request: span names: inference.request, inference.batch, model.load, kv.cache_hit, token.gen.
  - Sampling: 100% for the first 48h, then switch to 10% per Ben's note. We'll coordinate the schedule.
  - Export: Jaeger compatible HTTP exporter to your endpoint OR push traces to S3 as ndjson (we recommend live exporter to Jaeger endpoint for immediate debugging).

- Logs:
  - Format: JSON lines with fields: timestamp, request_id, user_id (if provided), model_version, prompt_type (short|long), token_count, response_tokens, latency_ms, error_code, fastretail_deal, env.
  - Export: Fluentd agent on Redwood side will push daily batches to s3://fastretail-poc-logs with 7d lifecycle (you can change). We'll also push metric summaries to CloudWatch metrics namespace /fastretail/poc.

- Metrics & Dashboards (Grafana):
  - POC Liveness: requests_per_sec, tokens_per_sec, active_connections, queue_depth
  - Inference Performance: p50/p90/p95 latency, batch_size_avg, model_load_time_ms, cold_start_count
  - Cost & Efficiency: tokens_per_dollar, batch_efficiency_ratio, projected_monthly_cost_by_volume
  - Error Analysis: 4xx_count, 5xx_count, error_rate_pct, oom_count, kernel_restart_count
  - Model Quality: reference_prompt_accuracy, hallucination_rate (we'll ingest your reference set results), rerank_score_avg

- Alerts: we'll configure alerting rules in Grafana / Alertmanager: p95>500ms (5m), error_rate>1% (5m), gpu_utilization>95% (2m), kv_cache_hit_ratio<60% (10m). Alerts will notify your Slack channel + email.

Ownership & access:
- Redwood (Marissa): create dashboards + initial trace export config, provide read-only Grafana link.
- FastRetail (Ben): provide Jaeger endpoint or S3 bucket + IAM role; create Slack channel #fastretail-poc for alerts.
- Redwood (Avery): will own cost breakdown and token-cost dashboard.

Timeline (target):
- Tue 6/16: Ben to provide IAM role and access details (confirmed in earlier message).
- Wed 6/17 morning: Redwood deploys trace/log exporters & shares Grafana links (ETA 10:00am PT).
- Thu 6/18: Quick smoke test window (2 hours) where we run synthetic load and confirm metrics export.
- Wed 7/1: End of POC sign-off meeting (results and next steps).

Notes on data retention & compliance:
- We'll redact any PII fields on request and can configure log masking for user identifiers. If you require that logs never leave your VPC, we can switch to agent-based push from your infra token (we discussed private connectors).

If this looks good I'll proceed with the dashboard deploy at 10am PT and send the Grafana/trace links.

Regards,
